description: Divider block — a focusable horizontal rule. Enter adds a Paragraph below; Backspace/Delete removes the block.

parameters.name: OnAddAfter
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed — parent should add a Paragraph block below.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace or Delete is pressed — parent should remove the block.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the block receives focus (click or Tab).
